related_questions.question: Is rental assistance still available in Colorado?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, rental assistance is still available in Colorado, but the specific programs and funding may vary. The Colorado Emergency Rental Assistance (CERA) program is currently active and provides assistance to eligible households. Additionally, some local governments and organizations offer their own rental assistance programs, so it's important to check with your specific city or county.
snippet_highlighted_words: Yes, rental assistance is still available in Colorado

list.title: 4. Review Program Information:
list.snippet: Carefully review the eligibility requirements and application process for any program you are interested in.

list.title: 5. Consider Legal Aid:
